data.title: Bitmine's Tom Lee Sees $6,000 Ethereum By Year-End If Bitcoin Hits $150,000
data.description: Tom Lee said Ethereum was still “vastly undervalued”, given its use in the settlement of AI agent transactions that legacy payment rails are unable to support.
data.keywords: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tom Lee, Lee, The Biggest Catalyst:, The CLARITY Act, 0.04, 2021, Stocktwits, AI, ETH, 6,000, 150,000
